The '''Buraka irstat''' was a [[Tarasin]] [[irstat]].

==History==
The Buraka irstat was responsible for protecting the [[sacred ch'hala tree grove]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. However, the grove was cut down by the [[Metatheran Cartel]] and the members of the irstat felt that they were forever shamed by their failure to protect it. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Cartel organized a celebration on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] and the members of the Buraka irstat believed that by attacking the event, they could gain revenge against the Cartel. The Tarasin [[Nyronusa]] released some dangerous creatures on Dorumaa, in the hope that they would attack everyone at the party. However, their plan was thwarted by the [[heroes of Cularin]].
